name: No more shopping simulator
author: Joshi
description: This mod tries to reduce the endless shopping in modded runs with close to infinite cash. Ctrl+F in shop to start selection mode. Spacebar over any item (in game or in collection) to select. Ctrl+F again after selecting items to activate the automatic reroll: the next reroll will keep rerolling the shop until you hit any of the marked items. Rerolling will stop if your money reaches 0, or hold Ctrl+F to stop manually. Shift+F will toggle "combo mode", which will keep auto-roll active even if Ctrl+F wasn't used. Alt+F will toggle whether cards are deselected when found.
